messages:
Noor: Heads-up — promo to prod is blocked, deploy-bot failed at canary artifact-upload.
deploy-bot: Promotion aborted: job `canary-integrations` failed (exit=1). Logs: https://ci.redwood/job/1746789012 :warning:
Noor: Quick log snippet shows multipart upload checksum mismatch during artifact-store handshake.
Sam: Reproduced locally with `builder:edge-2026-03-20`. Works with `builder:stable-2026-02-14`.
Helena: Likely proto/schema drift between new builder and cache server. Which PR bumped the toolchain? @Sam
Sam: PR #882 bumped bazel/toolchain and protobuf-gen. That landed in the last deploy.
Noor: We have a 2h change window starting soon. Options: pin promo to stable builder image (keep release) or block and roll back the toolchain bump (delay).
Helena: Pinning seems less disruptive. We'll need a follow-up: run a cache-compat canary matrix and roll forward with compatibility tests.
Sam: I can open a quick MR to pin the promo job to `redwood/builder:stable-2026-02-14` and trigger a rerun. ETA 18m.
infra-bot: Incident CI_UPLOAD_1746789012 created. Acknowledge within 45m to avoid escalation.
deploy-bot: Manual retrigger requested by Sam — job queued.
Noor: Also add a small release notes entry: "Promotion pinned to previous builder image due to artifact upload checksum drift; compatibility verification pending." Mark as `requires-followup` in the release tracker.
Helena: Add a pipeline change as well: temporary canary auto-retry with exponential backoff (3 attempts).
Sam: MR posted: https://git.redwood/infra/ci/-/merge_requests/427 — started canary rerun.
deploy-bot: Canary rerun in progress, step `artifact-upload` running.
Noor: If rerun succeeds we promote and schedule a post-release canary matrix to validate toolchain bump. If it fails we reconvene and decide on rolling the window.
Helena: I'll start a repro matrix across builder versions and cache server versions to capture exact proto mismatch and produce a minimal patch.
Noor: Thanks — executing pin path for now. Keep updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
